src.data package

Data Package. Includes loader and preprocessing modules.

Submodules

src.data.dataset module

MagNet Dataset Module.

This module provides a PyTorch Dataset wrapper for the MagNet data. It handles: 1. Loading the full dataset into memory. 2. Computing derived quantities (B, H, Power Loss). 3. Normalizing features. 4. Serving data based on the requested mode (‘scaler’, ‘sequence’, ‘seq2seq’).

src.data.loader module

Data Loading Module.

This module is responsible for loading experimental data from MATLAB (.mat) files. It handles both legacy (SciPy) and v7.3 (HDF5/h5py) formats.

Functions: - load_experiment(file_path, experiment_id): Loads data for a single experiment.

src.data.preprocessing.prepare_dataset(features, targets, test_ratio=0.2, norm_config=None)[source]

Generic function to split and normalize ANY set of features and targets.

Parameters:

  • features (dict) – Dictionary mapping FeatureName to data array.

  • targets (dict) – Dictionary mapping TargetName to data array.

  • test_ratio (float) – Fraction of data to use for testing.

  • norm_config (dict) – Dictionary mapping feature/target names to methods. e.g. {‘B’: ‘standard’, ‘Loss’: ‘log10’}. Defaults to ‘standard’ for features and ‘none’ for targets if not specified.

Returns:

Contains ‘train’ and ‘test’ dictionaries.

  • data_split[‘train’][‘inputs’][‘FeatureName’]

  • data_split[‘train’][‘targets’][‘TargetName’]

stats (dict): The statistics used for normalization for each feature/target.

Return type:

data_split (dict)
